source_text: Si Moysen, id est legem Dei, sequens agas hoc iter, columnam nubis et ignis habebis. Recede a tergo Aegypti; noli redire ad ollas carnium.
pass_a_gloss: If Moses, that-is law of-God, following you-drive this journey, pillar of-cloud and of-fire you-will-have. Withdraw from rear of-Egypt; do-not return to pots of-meats.
pass_b_english: If you walk this road following Moses — that is, God’s Law — you have the [[pillar of cloud and fire >> Bible:Exodus 13:21]]. Do not turn back to Egypt’s [[fleshpots >> Bible:Exodus 16:3]]; the rear-guard of Pharaoh still hopes you will.
